definitions.explanation: Describes something that displays many different colors or varieties. Creates a vivid, vibrant image.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}とりどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers of many colors are blooming.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}とりどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だった。
examples.english: The colorful autumn leaves were beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色|いろ}とりどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: A colorful array of dishes was lined up on the table.

notes:
{色|いろ}とりどり describes a vivid variety of colors or types. Used as a no-adjective ({色|いろ}とりどりの〜) or na-adjective ({色|いろ}とりどりな〜), with the ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ form being more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色|いろ}とりどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (colorful flowers)
- {色|いろ}とりどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧ (colorful autumn leaves)
- {色|いろ}とりどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (colorful vegetables)
- {色|いろ}とりどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧ (colorful costumes)

USAGE: While literally about color, it can also suggest variety and diversity in a broader sense. Always carries a positive, visually rich connotation.
